$meta.status: CONCEPT / EXAMPLE ONLY. Fictional test brand of whynotdesign. Not commercial final art. No trademark search has been done.
$meta.authority: This file is the single source of every visual number in the kit. tokens.css and motion.json are generated from it by tools/build_tokens.py; logos are generated from it by tools/make_marks.py. Markdown files name values by token only. To change a value: edit here, run both scripts, commit all outputs together.
$meta.estimates_warning: Every CMYK, Lab-target and print value below is a SCREEN-DERIVED ESTIMATE. CMYK was converted from sRGB with the generic 'Artifex CMYK SWOP' ICC profile (ghostscript default_cmyk.icc, relative colorimetric). It is NOT a press profile and has NOT been proofed. Spot colours are given as Lab targets only; no Pantone/DIC number has been chosen or verified. Proof on the real stock before any print run.

rice-paper.print_note: Prefer an uncoated natural/cream stock close to this colour so the ground is the paper, not ink. Only print it as a tint if the stock is white.

kiln-char.print_note: Profile output is 291% total ink: too heavy. Use K100 for text and lines under 10 pt / 0.5 mm; use a rich black (estimate C40 M40 Y40 K100, 220%) only for large solid areas. Proof.

oolong-amber.role: the note bar(s) only, plus large display numerals

celadon-grey.role: secondary fields: sachet / light-roast (level 1-2) ground, info panels

ember-red.role: exactly one dot per surface: the ember

contrast_wcag._rule: Body text only in kiln-char on rice-paper/celadon-grey, or rice-paper on kiln-char. Amber text only >= 24px / 18pt. Celadon never carries text on rice-paper. Ember never touches amber (1.05:1).

label.case: written in caps in the source text; CSS never transforms case (keeps DOM text identical to the whitelist)

scale_print_pt._note: 6 pt is a studio default minimum, not a legal figure. Check the labelling regulation of the selling market.

numeral_on_stave.font_size: stave height / 0.7 (DM Mono cap height is about 0.7 em)

radius._rule: The brand has no rounded corners. The ember dot is the only round shape.

mark._units: Abstract drawing units. Mark width = 240 units. All other numbers derive from these.
mark.clear_space: 1 line_gap (36 units = 15% of mark width) on every side

min_size._note: Below 80 px / 24 mm use the *_small.svg files (line_weight 6). Reversed (paper on char) minimum print width 24 mm. Estimates; proof.

score._what: The Roast Score: a batch's real roast log drawn on the stave. See magic_trick.md.
score.round_width: proportional to that round's hours, across the width left after rests
score.rest_label: rests are fixed gaps; their duration is written in mono, never scaled
score.line_for_round: roast intensity of that round, 1-5 (line counted from bottom)

brand_unit_5s._name: Stave -> Note -> Ember. One run, no loop. Times in ms from 0; total 5000 at 30 fps = 150 frames.

beats.what: 5 lines draw left->right, bottom line first, 80 ms stagger, 500 ms each, easing enter
the 3 signature bars (or the single level bar in a product unit) travel in from the right edge along their own space/line and land with spring note_land; 120 ms stagger, lowest first
ember dot scales 0 -> 1, easing enter, no glow, no flicker
焙曲 then TONEROAST rise 8 px + fade in, 60 ms container-then-text stagger
everything still (64 frames); the end frame is a valid static lockup

motion.reduced_motion: render the hold frame directly; 280 ms cross-fade from paper
